thread:
Sam: quick check-in on the OSS tutorial kit launch + webinar — want to capture follow-ups for content, bench narrative, and inbound routing :tada:
Maya: numbers first — 438 registered, 209 attended, 87 watched the recording so far. exported CSV linked in hubspot.
DevRelBot: hubspot export ready: https://hubspot.example.com/exports/oss-webinar-1927803331.csv
Leo: bench narrative draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-narrative-v1.md — includes basic latency/cost charts and the three workload profiles. needs stronger lead angle tho.
Zara: re: lead angle — propose two narratives to test: start-ups (fast iteration, low cost) vs platforms (predictable throughput, private deploy). different CTAs and example repos.
Sam: good — can we A/B subject lines and landing messaging for those two segments this week?
Maya: yes. I'll spin two email variants and two landing snippets. suggest we use these subject lines to test:
```
A) Hands-on: Build an LLM app in 30 minutes with Redwood (OSS tutorial)
B) Speed vs cost: real-world benchmarks + hands-on tutorial
```
Sam: perfect. include the UTM on both: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=oss_tutorial_q1_2026`
Ana: tagging in the refapp changes — small code sample tweak to make the quickstart run on CPU for local dev. PR in progress: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp/pull/412
Leo: for the benchmark narrative, add one short callout about "what we measured" (latency p50/p95, token cost rate, and scaling behavior). keep the graphs single-axis and annotated.
Maya: landing variations: startup page will emphasize quick local loop + free credits. platform page will emphasize Dedicated & Private deployment notes and SLA mention. I'll prepare copy by EOD Wednesday.
Sam: inbound routing — how are leads mapped post-webinar? we need a fast path for >50% engagement.
DevRelBot: leads summary: 87 watchers, 74 opened follow-up email, 48 flagged as high-engagement (>=60% video watched or demo click). Routing rule suggested -> Sales SDR queue for 48, Nurture drip for others. Link: https://airtable.example.com/base/oss-leads/1927803331
Zara: SDR queue ok but split by segment (startup vs platform). tag records with `segment:startups` or `segment:platforms` so SDRs can use tailored playbooks.
Sam: assign owners: Maya -> email + landing A/B; Leo -> bench narrative edits; Ana -> refapp PR + sample snippets; Zara -> segment definitions and SDR playbook updates; I'll handle routing rules and HubSpot automation.
Maya: noted — will post updated email copy and landing screenshots in this thread when ready.
Sam: one more ask — can we get a short dev-focused blog (500-700 words) that combines a tiny refapp walkthrough + quick benchmark table for social push? aim for publish Friday.
Leo: I can draft the blog — will keep it code-light, include the table and a link to the repo.
Ana: I'll make a tiny GIF of local dev flow for the blog and landing.
Sam: excellent. meeting if needed Thursday 10am to finalize assets. thanks everyone! :rocket:
